scope: Committed changes plus staged, unstaged and untracked implementation; the base and HEAD were equal when review began.
method: Check skill; two independent read-only reviewers: numerical/render and migration followed by general app review. A fresh general-agent spawn hit the harness thread limit, so the completed migration reviewer was reused for the general pass. Parent triaged against current source.

reviewers.scope: Core numerical framing, preflight, Split/InsertTime, exact plan traversal, renderer geometry/GPU/shader and tests
reviewers.execution: ripwire, rg, source/diff reads; no tests or GUI

reviewers.scope: DB23 to24 validation/backup/promotion, strict V17 snapshots/commands/patches, old pending redo, framing admission; then app Camera fields/routing, sessions, presentation identities, service commits and pause guard
reviewers.execution: ripwire, rg, source/diff reads, git diff --check; no tests or GUI

findings.claim: Source targets and motion vectors should rotate coded axes.
findings.reason: The API explicitly takes upright post-rotation source coordinates. SAR and90/270 display dimensions are applied before the rectangle. Rotating those coordinates again would double-rotate them.

findings.claim: Command-Z in a Camera field can reach project Undo because the generic text-focus helper knows only search/command IDs.
findings.fix: Camera routes field text shortcuts natively before project bindings, independent of the generic text flag. Explicit Command-N/O/I lifecycle actions still route globally. Regression includes false generic focus and true field focus, native undo/redo/clipboard/selection/Enter, and the project-history negative control.

parent_corrections.issue: Earlier count text could enter a field when Tab focused it later in the same native batch.
parent_corrections.fix: Retain only the ordered event suffix before focusing Camera fields. A headless negative-control regression reproduces the old leak and distinguishes the corrected result.

parent_corrections.issue: A fixed-width horizontal label/input row exceeded the168pt minimum inspector content width.
parent_corrections.fix: Stack unit-bearing labels above bounded fields; headless168pt no-overflow test.

parent_corrections.issue: Typed numeric values and same-frame Apply could use older data or tentative IME preedit.
parent_corrections.fix: Controlled bounded buffers, complete post-widget validation, precomposition snapshot restoration and explicit full-curve admission before Apply.

parent_corrections.issue: Native Camera displayed ordinary navigation/playback hints, a false inspector focus badge, duplicate field validation and unavailable picker keys.
parent_corrections.fix: Hide Normal controls while Camera is active, report actual field focus, draw each error once and show phase-specific hints. Verified in final native build 4df29f2d65ba76d2cdcf88f4c361a38d416a224270aeae26b3d297052896036e.

limits: No review-agent execution-based migration check; repository gate supplies it separately.
No native IME, VoiceOver, GPU/device fault injection or performance claim from code review.
Saved regions, tracking, full framed Ungroup and frozen-composition pause snapshots remain required work.
